evidence.rationale: Sampled PMID and DOI citation strings are not resolver anchors.

review_status.rationale: Sampled record headers explicitly state their workflow state.

curation_history.rationale: Sampled records show dated curation-event sections with attribution and action text.

source_link.rationale: Sampled record pages link their own YAML source file rather than just the repository root.

category_browse.rationale: Landing links lead into distinct category subsets with continuation where needed.

suite_nav.rationale: Visible suite-directory links occur in the reviewed navigation or footer.

downloads.rationale: Category indexes contain listing metadata and do not export complete environmental/taxon evidence records.

build_provenance.rationale: Generated from kg-microbe on 2026-08-16 dates the upstream source, not the current own-record corpus.

The same habitat has three different names depending on who is describing it. HabitatMech resolves them onto one ontology-grounded record and keeps every source's own account of it.

What HabitatMech adds

HabitatMech is not a re-labelling of ENVO. Most of what it holds, ENVO has no term for — and a concept that merely hangs under an ENVO term counts as new, because the identifier is minted precisely when the matched term is broader than the concept.

What the grounding status means

Every record says how well its identifier fits the source concept, separately from the recorded curation workflow status. A record can be reviewed and still honestly ungrounded — that combination is a well-formed request for a new ontology term, and there are 696 of them.
GROUNDING STATUS
BROAD	12	The identifier is broader — the best available term, losing specificity.

This corpus is machine-generated. 1915 of 3209 records have the SEEDED workflow status. The harmonization rules are documented and tested, but a lexical match between a source label and an ontology label is a plausible grounding, not a verified one.

REVIEWED records carry a recorded workflow decision, including agent-assisted curation. These counts do not establish human review. Consult the attributed curation events on each record for its provenance.
